title: xdrip+ looses connection to miaomiao2 frequently
body:
xdrip+ : latest beta version on LG G6 with Android 9
miaomiao2 : resetted and fully charged
freestyle libre sensor 1 : not the US version

Pairing and calibrating works well, but after some time, the connection gets lost and never comes  back.

Fun  fact:
If I install Glimp additionally, Glimp finds the miaomiao2 within seconds and takes the connection. As long as Glimp is running, xdrip+ has also connection to miaomiao2.
If I stop Glimp from running,  xdrip+  looses connection to miaomao2 after some time.

Maybe  xdrip+  doesn't (re)connect to miaomio2 properly?

comments.body:
Solved !
This helped: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/blob/master/Documentation/libre-fix-bt-connection-issues.md
Solution 3: Enable "Use scanning"
